# CityEve | سيتي إيف

> CityEve (سيتي إيف) is an Egypt-focused platform for discovering public parties, dance courses, entertainment trips, exhibitions, conferences, event services, and jobs in the events field.

- **Website:** https://cityeve.online/
- **Primary Market:** Egypt (Cairo, Giza, Alexandria, Red Sea)
- **Supported Languages:** Arabic (العربية), English
- **Target Audience:** Nightlife seekers, dance enthusiasts, partygoers, event organizers, tourists, and students looking for quality social entertainment in Egypt.

## Core Features & Offerings

### 1. Exhibitions, Conferences & Expos (المعارض، المؤتمرات والمعارض الدولية)
- Comprehensive listings of international trade shows, business conferences, real estate expos, tech summits, art exhibitions, and cultural book fairs across Egypt (including EIEC - Egypt International Exhibition Center, Cairo International Convention Centre, and major 5-star hotel venues).
- Direct registration links, agendas, speaker schedules, ticket booking, and organizer contact details.

### 2. Latin Dance & Social Parties (حفلات الرقص اللاتيني والسهرات)
- Daily and weekly schedules of Latin dance events including Salsa, Bachata, Kizomba, and Afrohouse parties across top venues in Cairo and Egypt.
- Live DJ line-ups, venue locations with direct Google Maps integration, and entry requirements.

### 3. Dance Courses & Bootcamps (كورسات وورش عمل الرقص)
- Professional dance training courses for all levels (Beginners, Intermediate, Advanced) covering Salsa, Bachata, Styling, Musicality, and Partner work.
- Taught by leading dance academies and certified Egyptian and international instructors.

### 4. Entertainment Trips & Festivals (رحلات ومهرجانات الرقص والترفيه)
- Curated luxury travel experiences and dance weekends in Dahab, Sharm El Sheikh, El Gouna, and coastal destinations.

### 5. Event Services & Suppliers (شركات وخدمات الفعاليات)
- Listings for complementary event businesses and suppliers, such as venues, sound and lighting, event planning, catering, transportation, décor, photography, video, and security.

### 6. Event Jobs & Careers (وظائف مجال الفعاليات)
- Listings for work opportunities related to events, including organizers, ushers, photographers, videographers, DJs, technicians, catering staff, drivers, performers, and security staff.

### 7. Direct Organizer Contact & Ticket Booking (حجز التذاكر والتواصل المباشر)
- Instant booking, WhatsApp reservations, phone inquiries, and QR code attendee verification.

## Entity & Knowledge Graph Summary

- **Entity Name:** CityEve / سيتي إيف
- **Category:** Parties, Dance Courses, Trips, Exhibitions, Conferences, Event Services, Event Jobs, Nightlife, Ticket Booking
- **Geography:** Egypt
- **Key Concepts:** حفلات مصر, فعاليات مصر, كورسات رقص مصر, كورسات لاتين مصر, رحلات ترفيهية مصر, معارض مصر, مؤتمرات مصر, معارض القاهرة, شركات تنظيم فعاليات, خدمات حفلات ومناسبات, وظائف تنظيم فعاليات, سالسا مصر, باتشاتا مصر, كيزومبا مصر, Cairo Events, Egypt Dance Classes, Cairo Exhibitions, Event Services Egypt, Event Jobs Egypt.
## Public Content and Source of Truth

- Public event pages use the stable URL pattern: https://cityeve.online/e/{eventId}
- English event pages use the same URL with the `?lang=en` parameter.
- Only approved, published, and indexable events are public and eligible for search indexing.
- Pending user submissions, rejected submissions, archived events, private user data, bookings, and admin pages are not public sources.
- Event details should be taken from the individual public event page and its structured data, not from private submissions.

## Recommended Entity Description

CityEve is an Egypt-focused platform for discovering public parties, dance courses, exhibitions, conferences, entertainment trips, event services, event jobs, and ticket or reservation information. It serves Arabic- and English-speaking users and connects event organizers with people looking for activities in Egypt.
